nested_selection.estimand: Out-of-fold performance of the declared selection procedure on development records; folds and repeats are not independent studies.

paired_test_comparisons.direction: candidate minus reference; negative favors candidate for these losses
paired_test_comparisons.scope: Post-hoc pointwise intervals, conditional on fixed models and observed class counts; no multiplicity adjustment or retraining uncertainty.

clinical_scope: Educational post-FNA feature analysis. No pre-biopsy triage claim, validated action costs, target-population prevalence, or deployment recommendation.
